title: Day 17/28 - Azure App Service With Terraform | Blue Green Deployment
description:
Welcome to 17/28 day of Terraform Full Course For Beginners

In this video, we will learn how to implement Blue-Green Deployment with Azure App Service using Terraform! This step-by-step tutorial shows you how to create and manage deployment slots for zero-downtime deployments.

📚 In this video, you'll learn:
- Setting up Azure App Service Plan and App Service with Terraform
- Creating and configuring deployment slots
- Deploying a sample application to slots
- Implementing blue-green deployment using Terraform
- Executing slot swaps for zero-downtime updates
